new.note: Haggis rolled in oat crumbs and fried crisp, with whisky mustard mayo by the lodge fire.
new.how: Haggis rolled into balls, crumbed in oats and fried crisp, with a whisky mustard mayo. Roll 400g haggis into 16 balls. Dust in 50g plain flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs and roll in 100g fine oatmeal. Fry at 175C for 3 minutes until crisp and hot through. Stir 120g mayonnaise with 1 tbsp wholegrain mustard and 2 tsp whisky.

r2.make_ahead: Crumb the bonbons up to a day ahead and keep them chilled; fry on the night

steps.text: Roll the haggis into 16 small balls.
Dust them in flour, dip in the egg and roll in the oatmeal.
Heat the oil to 175C and fry in batches until crisp and hot through.
Stir the mayonnaise with the mustard and whisky and serve alongside.
Roll the haggis into 16 small balls.
Dust them in flour, dip in the egg and roll in the oatmeal.
Heat the oil to 175C and fry in batches until crisp and hot through.
Stir the mayonnaise with the mustard and lemon juice and serve alongside.

new.af: Haggis rolled in oat crumbs and fried crisp, with lemon mustard mayo.

new.note: Griddled potato scones under black pudding, a fried quail egg and brown sauce, a lodge breakfast.
new.how: Potato scones griddled in butter, topped with black pudding, a fried quail egg and brown sauce. Mash 400g floury potatoes with 30g butter and 1/2 tsp salt, work in 80g plain flour and roll 5mm thick. Cut into 8 triangles and griddle 3 minutes a side. Fry 8 slices black pudding for 2 minutes a side. Fry 8 quail eggs. Stack and add brown sauce.

r2.make_ahead: Make the scones up to a day ahead and re-griddle to serve

steps.text: Boil the potatoes until soft, drain and mash with the butter and salt.
Work in the flour, roll 5mm thick and cut into 8 triangles.
Griddle the scones in a dry pan until speckled brown, 3 minutes a side.
Fry the black pudding 2 minutes a side, then fry the quail eggs.
Top each scone with black pudding and an egg, and add brown sauce.

new.note: Potato wedges roasted crisp in olive oil, lemon and oregano, feta crumbled over at the Great Hall.
new.how: Potato wedges roasted crisp in olive oil, lemon juice, garlic and oregano, with feta crumbled over. Cut 1kg potatoes into wedges and toss with 60ml olive oil, the juice of 2 lemons, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 2 tsp dried oregano and salt. Roast at 210C for 45 minutes, turning once, until crisp and golden. Crumble 80g feta over to serve.

r2.make_ahead: Cut the wedges a few hours ahead and keep them in cold water; dry well before roasting

steps.text: Heat the oven to 210C. Toss the wedges with the oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano and salt.
Roast, turning once, until crisp and golden.
Crumble the feta over to serve.

new.note: Lamb shoulder baked slow in paper with garlic, lemon, oregano and potatoes, a feast for a queen.
new.how: Lamb shoulder sealed in baking paper with garlic, lemon, oregano and potatoes, baked low until it falls apart. Rub 1.5kg lamb shoulder with 4 crushed garlic cloves, the juice of a lemon, 2 tsp dried oregano, 2 tbsp olive oil and salt. Sit it on 800g halved potatoes and 2 sliced onions, wrap tight in baking paper and foil and bake at 160C for 3 hours 30 minutes. Open, raise to 200C and brown for 20 minutes.

r2.make_ahead: Rub the lamb the night before and keep it covered in the fridge

steps.text: Heat the oven to 160C. Rub the lamb with the garlic, lemon juice, oregano, oil and salt.
Sit it on the potatoes and onions, wrap tight in baking paper and foil.
Bake low until the lamb falls apart.
Open the parcel, raise the oven to 200C and brown.
Pull the lamb into pieces and serve with the potatoes and juices.

old: Veld Belgian ale with orange and honey

new.note: Chilled white wine stirred with warm honey and orange peel, the old Greek oenomeli for an Amazon toast.
new.how: White wine sweetened with warm honey and orange peel, chilled and poured over ice. Warm 80g honey with the peel of an orange and 60ml water until runny, cool, then stir into a 750ml bottle of chilled dry white wine. Pour over ice with an orange twist.

r2.make_ahead: Make the honey syrup a day ahead and keep it chilled

steps.text: Warm the honey, the peel of one orange and the water until runny.
Cool the syrup, then stir it into the chilled wine.
Pour over ice with a twist of the other orange.
Warm the honey with the peel of one orange until runny.
Cool, then stir into the grape juice and soda water.
Pour over ice with a twist of the other orange.

new.af: Chilled white grape and soda stirred with warm honey and orange peel, for an Amazon toast.
